  • Develop AI agents that conduct multi-step research and qualification processes autonomously
  • Build conversational systems that handle routine inquiries and escalate complex cases appropriately
  • Create intelligent routing and matching systems that optimize business outcomes using historical data and ML models
  • Design automated scheduling and coordination systems that handle complex business logic and constraints
  • System Integration & Data Orchestration:
  • Connect internal platforms with external third-party services, handling authentication, rate limiting, and error recovery
  • Build real-time data synchronization pipelines that keep multiple systems consistent
  • Create webhook listeners and event processors that trigger automated workflows based on external events
  • Design data enrichment pipelines that pull information from multiple sources and merge it intelligently
  • Operational Intelligence & Monitoring:
  • Build automated alerting and notification systems that detect anomalies and trigger appropriate responses
  • Create dashboards and reporting workflows that aggregate data from multiple sources
  • Develop predictive systems that use historical patterns to forecast operational needs
  • Design automated quality control systems that continuously validate data accuracy across systems
  • AI Innovation & Experimentation:
  • Prototype new AI capabilities using the latest LLM models and techniques
  • Experiment with vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation(RAG)
  • Build proof-of-concepts that demonstrate the business value of emerging AI technologies
  • Contribute to our Technical Innovation Program (TIP) with novel automation approaches
  • Platform & Infrastructure:
  • Develop reusable automation components, templates, and design patterns
  • Create internal tooling that makes it easier for other teams to build and deploy automations
  • Establish monitoring, logging, and observability standards for automation workflows
  • Build testing frameworks that ensure automation reliability and catch regressions
  • These projects span multiple teams and business functions - you'll have the opportunity to work on whatever creates the most business value, from carrier operations to customer experience to internal productivity tools.

title: Sênior de Auditoria Externa - Remoto
description:
Seja um #NewPurple na Grant Thornton Brasil!

O que esperar da Grant Thornton?

Valorizamos nossas pessoas e direcionamos todos os nossos esforços para a constante construção de uma cultura organizacional mais diversa e inclusiva. Somos apaixonados pelo sucesso das nossas equipes e alto desempenho junto a nossos clientes. Fazemos parte de uma rede global de 140 países. Por isso, temos o alcance e capacidade de direcionar sua carreira para onde você deseja ir.

Mantemos uma cultura de aprendizado e crescimento contínuo, encorajando nossos profissionais a aproveitar oportunidades e atingir todo o seu potencial. Temos um amplo programa de desenvolvimento de carreira adequado aos seus objetivos e às áreas de negócio da nossa empresa.

Aqui na Grant Thornton Brasil, temos espaço para todo mundo. Afinal, contamos com muitas outras cores por trás do nosso roxo!

Além disso, oferecemos ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e que atendem às necessidades pessoais e profissionais de nossos colaboradores, nesse processo, acreditamos que todos estarão mais engajados e energizados para desempenhar suas atividades, mantendo a qualidade de vida. Não é só sobre falar. É sobre agir!


Principais Responsabilidades/Atividades

  • Coordenar os trabalhos de auditoria, auxiliando e engajando o time;
  • Demonstrar adequado conhecimento de conceitos de auditoria, contabilidade e ferramentas utilizadas no trabalho de auditoria externa;
  • Adaptar os trabalhos às características e peculiaridades de cada cliente, criando um bom nível de relacionamento com eles.
  • Demonstrar conhecimentos em contabilidade e auditoria, impostos e tecnologia.
  • Demonstrar habilidade de planejamento, organização do trabalho e distribuição de tarefas para equipe;
  • Realizar a orientação e treinamento “on-the-job” dos Trainees e Associates;
  • Revisar os trabalhos de auditoria e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Controlar e monitorar as horas para realização do trabalho, informando o gerente responsável.
  • Profissional atenderá projetos de clientes da divisão de indústria e serviços

Experiência Desejável

  • 3 anos em Auditoria

Formação Acadêmica

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando. Área de formação: Ciências Contábeis

Conhecimentos

  • Pacote Office
  • Matemática Financeira
  • Inglês Intermediário (Desejável)

Habilidades e Atitudes Desejáveis

  • Visão analítica / crítica
  • Organização
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal
  • Comprometimento
  • Confidencialidade
  • Pro atividade
  • Autodesenvolvimento

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Work Model :Remote

Location :Remote BR/Latam

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform . In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.


Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Collaboration with other engineers working primarily in PST


Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Desenvolvedor Angular
description:
Sobre a FourD

A FourD atua apoiando seus clientes na concepção, implementação e evolução de produtos financeiros e jornadas digitais complexas, trabalhando em ambientes críticos, regulados e de alta escala. Atendemos grandes players como Nubank, Banco Next e Natura Pay, sempre com foco em qualidade, segurança e excelência técnica.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend Angular Sênior / Especialista, com forte maturidade técnica, para atuar como referência no time, contribuindo na definição de padrões, arquitetura frontend e evolução de aplicações financeiras.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações frontend em Angular (versões recentes), com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura frontend, padrões de componentização e boas práticas
  • Implementar interfaces responsivas, acessíveis e orientadas à experiência do usuário
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST em ambientes financeiros críticos
  • Lidar com fluxos complexos de negócio, validações e regras financeiras no frontend
  • Definir e garantir estratégias de testes automatizados (unitários e end-to-end)
  • Atuar como referência técnica em code reviews, promovendo qualidade e padronização
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança no frontend, observabilidade e performance
  • Documentar decisões técnicas, arquitetura e padrões adotados
  • Colaborar com times de produto, UX/UI, backend e QA


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Angular (versões 12+)
  • Domínio de TypeScript, HTML5 e CSS3
  • Conhecimento avançado em RxJS, gerenciamento de estado e arquitetura frontend
  • Experiência com consumo de APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de segurança frontend
  • Experiência com testes unitários (Jasmine, Karma ou similares)
  • Vivência com testes end-to-end (Cypress, Playwright ou similares)
  • Uso de Git e pipelines de CI/CD


Diferenciais

  • Vivência em fintechs, instituições bancárias ou empresas do setor financeiro
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo crédito, onboarding, pagamentos, antifraude ou score de risco
  • Conhecimento em integrações com birôs de crédito e consumo de dados financeiros


Soft Skills

  • Forte senso de ownership e responsabilidade técnica
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e colaboração constante
  • Visão crítica, atenção a detalhes e foco em qualidade
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos e regulados


Modelo: Remoto | Contratação: PJ + Benefícios

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Application Support Developer (Java / MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Support Developer with strong experience in Java and MySQL to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server errors, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (MySQL): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and MySQL
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Analista de Negócio de Tecnologia
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Negócio de Tecnologia



Resumo:

Estamos em busca de um profissional com profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, experiência comprovada na coleta de requisitos e atuação como Scrum Master, além de um backgroud em desenvolvimento de sistemas. O candidato ideal deve demonstrar habilidades em liderança de projetos e ser capaz de atuar como facilitador de equipes ágeis, assegurando a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.



Atribuições :


  • Liderar projetos: Coordenar equipes e garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Auxiliar na definição e levantamento de requisitos: Elaborar e documentar histórias de usuário, assegurando que estejam claras, completas e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio.
  • Elaborar e monitorar status reports: Acompanhar KPIs e métricas de desempenho dos projetos, fornecendo informações precisas sobre o progresso e as áreas de melhoria.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico ao time de desenvolvimento: Ajudar na resolução de problemas técnicos, apoiar a tomada de decisões e facilitar a comunicação eficaz entre os membros da equipe.
  • Colaborar com diversas áreas interdependentes: Trabalhar com diferentes equipes e stakeholders, tanto dentro quanto fora do departamento de TI, para garantir que os projetos atendam às expectativas e requisitos das partes interessadas.
  • Atuar como Scrum Master: Facilitar a execução das reuniões e eventos ágeis, promovendo a adoção das melhores práticas e garantindo a eficiência dos processos ágeis.
  • Prestar consultoria e suporte aos clientes internos: Orientar sobre as regras de negócio dos sistemas em utilização e assegurar que as soluções atendam às suas necessidades.



Requisitos :

* Experiência mínima de 6 anos como Scrum Master ou analista de desenvolvimento, com atuação em levantamento de requisitos.

* Formação superior completa ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas de tecnologia.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Experiência prévia como Scrum Master ou em um papel similar de liderança de projetos ágeis;
  • Sólido conhecimento e experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas;
  • Experiência em liderança e gestão de projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Azure DevOps ou Jira.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Conhecimento em Linux;
  • Conhecimento na plataforma Azure (provisionamento, acesso e gerenciamento de recursos);
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);
  • Certificação de SCRUM Master.



Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado fundamental;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais

title: Data Analyst
description:
Título do Cargo: Analista de Dados

Nível: 4 ou 5

O que você fará:

  • Ter mentalidade de crescimento, identificando desafios e oportunidades de negócio e resolvendo-os por meio de análise e mineração de dados.
  • Apoiar análises e fornecer insights sobre uso de produto, performance de campanhas, métricas de funil, segmentação, conversão e crescimento de receita.
  • Desenvolver análises ad-hoc, projetos de longo prazo, relatórios e dashboards para gerar novos insights e medir o progresso das iniciativas-chave.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com stakeholders para entender necessidades analíticas, métricas críticas e KPIs.
  • Colaborar com diferentes times da organização para compreender requisitos e necessidades de negócio.
  • Criar e apresentar análises que traduzam problemas complexos em insights claros e acionáveis.


Requisitos Mínimos:

  • Graduação ou nível superior em área quantitativa.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em funções de análise de dados.
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência com Python, SQL e ferramentas de visualização como Tableau, Looker ou Power BI.
  • Histórico comprovado de tomada de decisão e resolução de problemas baseada em dados.
  • Forte visão de negócio, liderança e integridade.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade de influência estratégica e negociação.
  • Perfil proativo, adaptável e confortável em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Forte domínio de ferramentas de BI e Excel (Power BI é um diferencial).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com técnicas de mineração de dados, incluindo aprendizado supervisionado e não supervisionado.
  • Vivência com AWS e programação em Spark/PySpark.
  • Conhecimento em Airflow para orquestração de workflows.
  • Background em marketing digital, vendas e/ou estratégia.
  • Capacidade de colaborar de forma eficaz em ambientes multifuncionais e matriciais.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de software, dados e integrações com IA , garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com vivência como referência técnica, arquiteto ou liderança técnica de times.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

  • Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos
  • APIs REST e boas práticas de API First
  • Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software
  • Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps
  • Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud)
  • Banco de dados relacionais, PostgreSQL ou equivalentes
  • NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes
  • Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes
  • IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações
  • Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes
  • DevOps: CI e CD, Git, GitFlow, Docker, Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código
  • Provedores de cloud, GCP, AWS ou Azure
  • Observabilidade (Logs estruturados, métricas e traces)
  • Atuação em ambientes distribuídos com foco em confiabilidade (Troubleshooting em produção)
  • Metodologias ágeis

Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de software, dados e integrações com IA , garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com vivência como referência técnica, arquiteto ou liderança técnica de times.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

  • Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos
  • APIs REST e boas práticas de API First
  • Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software
  • Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps
  • Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud)
  • Banco de dados relacionais, PostgreSQL ou equivalentes
  • NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes
  • Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes
  • IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações
  • Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes
  • DevOps: CI e CD, Git, GitFlow, Docker, Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código
  • Provedores de cloud, GCP, AWS ou Azure
  • Observabilidade (Logs estruturados, métricas e traces)
  • Atuação em ambientes distribuídos com foco em confiabilidade (Troubleshooting em produção)
  • Metodologias ágeis

title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer (JavaScript, PHP, linux)
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on linux, nginx (engine x), fpm and mostly mysql
  • Modernize software solution using React.js and/or Vue.js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain
  • Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications
  • Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient
  • Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • Analysis and design
  • Estimating
  • Planning


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • 4+ years of experience using JavaScript, PHP, and linux
  • Passion for whole product delivery and exceptional customer experiences must have experience considering architectural side-effects, edge-cases, backward compatibility, integrations, and internal/external team/customer enablement
  • Experience building, delivering, and sustaining production, commercial-quality, n-tiered software architecture web-based applications
  • Prior success as a senior developer coaching less skilled/experienced developers, establishing coding guidelines/best-practices, and reviewing pull requests
  • Familiarity with varied data capture, normalization/transformation, and storage/management that enable high-performance data querying for reporting
  • Experience working with Agile and other development methodologies
  • Ability to work independently yet know when to seek assistance to be sure to achieve deadlines with high quality
  • Team player with effective communication skills and collaborative approach
  • Strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly
  • Flexibility and openness to new ideas or change with the passion and drive to excel in their career
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, creative, and accountable


Preferred experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiar with nginx web server (aka \"Engine X\")
  • Experience with React.js or Vue.js
  • Familiarity with upstream and midstream oil/gas industry


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Arquiteto de dados
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Dados com experiência em Microsoft Azure e Databricks , para liderar iniciativas de governança e arquitetura de dados em projetos estratégicos. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem visão consultiva e gosta de ambientes dinâmicos e colaborativos, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e resilientes usando Microsoft Azure (Synapse, Fabric, Data Factory, Purview, AD) e Databricks .
  • Definir e implementar pipelines ETL/ELT (Data Factory, Databricks, Spark, SQL) com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e custo.
  • Criar e operacionalizar camada de governança: catálogo de dados, lineage, políticas de acesso (RLS , RBAC ), classificação de sensibilidade e masking.
  • Estabelecer práticas de data quality , contratos de dados e SLAs de ingestão/transformação.
  • Garantir aderência a LGPD/GDPR e melhores práticas de segurança (encryption, key management).
  • Documentar arquiteturas, padrões e runbooks; defender decisões técnicas em comitês de arquitetura.
  • Mentorar engenheiros e analistas, promovendo boas práticas, code reviews e automação (CI/CD para infra e pipelines).
  • Liderar PoCs e provas de valor, estimar esforços e mapear custos (cloud spend / FinOps mindset).
  • Colaborar com Product Owners para alinhar roadmap técnico com objetivos de negócio e time-to-market.

title: Senior React Developer (React.js / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior React Developer with 5+ years of professional front-end software development experience using React.js and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will help design, build, and maintain high-impact user interfaces - from customer dashboards and data visualizations to a React Native mobile application.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Develop rich, performant web applications using React.js, Next.js, TailwindCSS, and Shadcn
  • Build and maintain reusable components and front-end architecture to support renewing the growing product ecosystem
  • Lead implementation of the design system and UX layer in coordination with the client's design team
  • Collaborate with back-end and full-stack engineers to ensure consistent integration with Supabase and other platform services
  • Support and enhance the client's existing React Native mobile application as part of a unified team delivering cross-platform experiences
  • Balance iterative MVP delivery with scalable, maintainable engineering practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in front-end engineering with React.js and TypeScript
  • Proven track record delivering web applications using React.js, Next.js, and TailwindCSS
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Exposure to data visualization tools, such as D3.js, Recharts, or Mapbox
  • Experience using AI tooling, such as Cursor and CoPilot
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience working with React Native and cross-platform design systems
  • Experience with shadcn UI
  • Familiarity with Supabase or similar backend-as-a-service tools
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as D3.js, Recharts, or Mapbox


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior React Developer with 5+ years of professional front-end software development experience using React.js and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will help design, build, and maintain high-impact user interfaces - from customer dashboards and data visualizations to a React Native mobile application.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Develop rich, performant web applications using React.js, Next.js, TailwindCSS, and Shadcn
  • Build and maintain reusable components and front-end architecture to support renewing the growing product ecosystem
  • Lead implementation of the design system and UX layer in coordination with the client's design team
  • Collaborate with back-end and full-stack engineers to ensure consistent integration with Supabase and other platform services
  • Support and enhance the client's existing React Native mobile application as part of a unified team delivering cross-platform experiences
  • Balance iterative MVP delivery with scalable, maintainable engineering practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in front-end engineering with React.js and TypeScript
  • Proven track record delivering web applications using React.js, Next.js, and TailwindCSS
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Exposure to data visualization tools, such as D3.js, Recharts, or Mapbox
  • Experience using AI tooling, such as Cursor and CoPilot
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience working with React Native and cross-platform design systems
  • Experience with shadcn UI
  • Familiarity with Supabase or similar backend-as-a-service tools
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as D3.js, Recharts, or Mapbox


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior Tax Consultant
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Tax One e DFE , com forte experiência em suporte funcional e operacional de soluções fiscais brasileiras .


Contrato: Part-time

Local: 100% Remoto


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar no suporte funcional das soluções fiscais Tax One e DFE , analisando e resolvendo tickets relacionados a obrigações fiscais.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs , assegurando qualidade e prazos nas entregas.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato entre áreas fiscais, times de negócio, TI e fornecedores de soluções fiscais .
  • Analisar erros, rejeições e inconsistências em documentos fiscais eletrônicos .
  • Apoiar na parametrização, validação e testes de regras fiscais.
  • Identificar riscos fiscais, gargalos operacionais e propor melhorias nos processos e no modelo de suporte .


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência como Especialista em Tax One e DFE ou atuação similar como Consultor(a) Fiscal .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da legislação fiscal brasileira .
  • Experiência com gestão de tickets e SLAs em ambientes de suporte.
  • Vivência prática com documentos fiscais eletrônicos (NF-e, NFS-e, CT-e, MDF-e, entre outros).
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com times de TI e negócio.
  • Inglês obrigatório.


Interessados enviar CV, disponibilidade e rate para ou aplicar diretamente.

title: Tech Lead Machine Learning/Data Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Work with a high skilled team to leverage complex and high quality machine learning and statistical models;
  • Implement model to service integration via DAG creations and ETL processes;
  • Evaluate model performance under real data testing results and remodelate accordingly;
  • Build scalable models and DAGs to enable new workflows creations in a high-usage, high-demand environment;
  • Work with worldwide multidisciplinary distributed team, participate in technical discussions and definitions using English as main communication language;
  • Leverage accurate model architecture and documentation.



Essential Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Physics or related areas;
  • Desire to combine theory and abilities to solve problems pragmatically, applying Machine Learning techniques and integrating them into larger systems;
  • Desire to work with product managers and software engineers, translating requirements into design and models into end-to-end production code;
  • Knowledge in probability and statistical modeling;
  • Hands-on experience in statistical analysis and Machine Learning modeling using Python;
  • Hands-on experience on model evaluation, integration, data transformation and deployment, covering the complete end-to-end cycle;
  • Knowledge in SQL and relational databases;
  • Knowledge with DAG definition and implementation.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Python notebooks, pandas;
  • Experience with PySpark, Airflow;
  • Experience with cloud tools (AWS, Azure, GCP) and orchestration tools;
  • Knowledge about model life cycle, data drift and model drift;
  • Experience with data structures;
  • Experience with finops data treatment and cost saving analysis.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of professional full stack software development experience to join our U.K. / U.S. client. You will help build the foundation of the client's back-end and data systems. The role will focus on platform development using Supabase, TypeScript, and modern web frameworks, enabling robust data pipelines, operations automation, and API integrations that support the client's growing applications.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and extend back-end systems using Supabase, leveraging database, auth, and edge function capabilities
  • Develop and maintain TypeScript-based APIs and integrations that underpin the client's platform and data services
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to deliver end-to-end features and performant, user-facing experiences
  • Contribute to the evolution of the client's internal automation tools and data pipeline implementations
  • Work closely with product, data, and AI teams on new integrations from analytics and forecasting to blockchain-enabled features
  • Ensure reliability, performance, and scalability while maintaining lightweight, maintainable systems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in full stack or back-end development with strong proficiency in TypeScript
  • Practical experience with Supabase (preferred) or NextJS, Express, or other TypeScript frameworks
  • Solid understanding of API design, database schema design, and serverless architecture patterns
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Experience using AI tooling, such as Cursor and CoPilot
  • Experience working independently in Agile, distributed teams
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Familiarity with AI or ML integrations at the application level
  • Knowledge of blockchain, digital asset verification, or sustainability data systems
  • Experience with data visualization, analytics tools, or geospatial data


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e seguir metodologias ágeis;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.

title: Oracle Business System Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Oracle Fusion who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

We are seeking an Oracle Business Systems Analyst (BSA), with functional experience with Oracle ERP Cloud, Supply Chain processes and Oracle GTM (Global Trade Management) module. Optionally, also have experience with both of the Order to Cash and Procure to Pay business processes and modules including (but not limited to): AP, AR, G/L, Cash Management, Order Management, and Inventory. This BSA will help define the integration of our GTM Application with Oracle products. Our ONESOURCE Integrations for Oracle is a key component of our product suite. As an Oracle BSA, he will be responsible for developing functional requirement, API mapping specs, test cases plans, validating acceptance criteria and documentation, as related to the integration processes between Oracle and ONESOURCE Global Trade.



Tasks Performed :


• Work closely with customers, prospects and Product Management in setting the direction of current and future the ONESOURCE Global Trade Integration for Oracle as well as helping to continue to maintain ONESOURCE Global Trade integration for Oracle competitive differentiation.


• Perform detailed analysis of ONSOURCE business integration with Oracle modules, primarily GTM to determine opportunities to strengthen and expand integration design.


• Prepare detailed Oracle Integration Requirement Specs & Functional Documentation with associated use cases, Define interface mapping rules, PowerPoint presentations, and other documents to explain requirements to Development, support teams, partners and customers.


• Demonstrate the ability to research and understand Oracle Fusion APIs.


• Perform feature validation of functionality, QA in test script creation and automation, and assist with end-user documentation


• Perform Oracle application configuration settings and options for relevant modules


• Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Support and Professional Services staff



Essential Functions:


• Maintain a working relationship with internal customers including Product Development, Professional Services, Customer Advocacy, as well as Oracle via the Oracle Partner Program


• Gather, define and document Oracle business requirements


• Work closely with application developers, other BSA’s and QA testers throughout the entire product life cycle


• Participate in customer calls, visits and meetings to gather requirements and resolve issues


• Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to partner domain experts. Follow product into the field to ensure customer success.


• Support current products, including 2nd level support analysis, patch assessment, and work-around investigation


• Provide business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.



Desired Job Experience:


• Requires a minimum of 1-3 years functional experience in key Oracle modules (Supply Chain Management and GTM), including requirements gathering, design, configuration, unit testing and integration testing.


• Experience with a full life cycle Oracle implementations


• Experience with Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) required


• Strong analytical, design and documentation skills


• Oracle design, configuration and hands on experience


• Exposure to broad financial processes and systems experience across quote-to-cash and procure-to-pay business functions (billing, order management, accounts receivable, purchasing, accounts payable, general ledger.)


• Experience with standard financial processes and ability to overlay the process understanding onto multiple financial business systems packages.


• Previous experience working in a software company strongly desired.


• Desirable experience in Oracle modules AP, AR, G/L, Order Management and Purchasing .


• Previous work with Oracle R12 EBS is a plus


• Experience with ONESOURCE Global Trade will be a plus



Other Qualifications:


• Excellent communication and presentation skills in interacting with management and communicating functional vision to both internal and external constituencies


• Strong customer-facing experience and skills.


• Experience with Agile Product Delivery Process , specifically Scrum is a plus


• Strong communication and presentation skills


• Technical/ Oracle development experience (Foundation, SQL*Plus, System Administration) is a plus


• Technical experience working with APIs (SOAP and REST) and API tools, such as SoapUi and Postman is a plus


• Ability to multi-task and work under tight deadlines in a fast paced environment

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Consultor SAP FI/CO
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em parceria com um cliente de grande porte, em projetos estratégicos e relevantes, com foco em transformação digital e modernização de processos financeiros em ambiente SAP S/4HANA . O projeto terá início previsto para 19/01/2026 , com tempo de contrato de 6 meses e possibilidade de extensão, atuando em iniciativas voltadas a incorporação societária (M&A).


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Consultor(a) SAP FI/CO Sênior em ambiente SAP S/4HANA
  • Participar de projetos de incorporação societária (M&A)
  • Configurar, acompanhar e dar suporte aos processos financeiros no SAP FI/CO
  • Interface com áreas de negócio e times técnicos
  • Garantir aderência às melhores práticas SAP e qualidade das entregas


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação acadêmica obrigatória
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada nos módulos SAP FI/CO
  • Conhecimento consolidado em SAP S/4HANA
  • Atuação prévia em projetos SAP


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência em projetos de incorporação societária (M&A)
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade de interação com stakeholders
  • Organização, autonomia e gestão do tempo
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e resiliente


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Experiência sólida com Node.js e desenvolvimento de APIs Domínio de .NET (C#) e ASP.NET Core e Node ,conhecimento avançado em Angular (preferencialmente versões 20)

Versionamento de código com Git Conhecimento em TypeScript Ingles intermediario

Experiência com NestJS Conhecimento em arquitetura de microserviços Conhecimento em arquitetura de microfrontend Familiaridade com Docker e containerização Experiência com Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD RxJS e programação reativa Testes unitários e de integração (Jest, xUnit) Conhecimento em padrões de projeto Diferenciais Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS) Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: .NET/C# - React (Fullstack)
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. You will play a fundamental part in delivering a robust and scalable user experience, working in a supportive, team-oriented environment alongside other engineers and product stakeholders to bring new capabilities to life.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, ensuring code is clean, performant, and adheres to high-quality standards;
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary teams—including Product, QA, and UX—in agile settings to deliver resilient solutions that support strategic business objectives;
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and propose architectural improvements to optimize platform performance and reliability;
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, promoting best development practices and contributing to team growth.


Essential Skills

  • Experience with the .NET/C# ecosystem for backend development and React for frontend in cloud-based (SaaS) environments;
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with AWS cloud platform (preferred), microservices architecture, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Deep knowledge of SQL and database design for both relational and non-relational systems (Postgres, MongoDB);
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and DevOps practices;
  • Knowledge or hands-on experience with the Angular framework for frontend development.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.


The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).


What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.


About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment


End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.


Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE - DevOps
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) SRE Sênior para atuar em ambientes críticos e altamente escaláveis, garantindo confiabilidade, performance e segurança em soluções baseadas em AWS. Além das responsabilidades técnicas, você também será um parceiro estratégico do time de pré-venda , ajudando a entender as necessidades dos clientes e propondo as melhores soluções.


Se você tem experiência sólida em infraestrutura, automação e práticas DevOps, e gosta de atuar próximo ao negócio, essa oportunidade é para você!



Responsabilidades

  • Definir soluções de infraestrutura em cloud AWS e dar suporte em todo o ciclo de vida dos serviços (arquitetura, implantação e operação).
  • Apoiar o time de pré-venda, entendendo as necessidades dos clientes e sugerindo soluções adequadas.
  • Elevar a resiliência dos ambientes, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e monitoramento proativo.
  • Planejar e executar processos e soluções com base em dados e boas práticas.
  • Desenvolver componentes e APIs para suportar equipes e melhorar a gestão do time de SRE.
  • Participar da resolução de incidentes críticos e crises.
  • Construir processos e boas práticas para evoluir a visão de confiabilidade.
  • Garantir requisitos de segurança e compliance.
  • Gerenciar esteiras de CI/CD e promover integração entre ferramentas e provisionamento.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Formação superior em TI, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com IaC (Terraform, Atlantis).
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Processos de CI/CD (Jenkins, Groovy).
  • Infraestrutura e redes.
  • Orquestração de containers (ECS, Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Sistemas Linux.
  • AWS (Route53, ECS, SQS, STS, API Gateway, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFront, SSM, WAF, GuardDuty, Inspector, CloudWatch).
  • Sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Arquitetura de mensageria (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ).


Diferenciais

  • Certificações AWS (Associate ou Professional).

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .NET Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Oportunidade para: Desenvolvedor(a) .Net Sênior


Responsável pelo desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de sistemas corporativos utilizando tecnologias .NET, assegurando alta qualidade, segurança e performance. Atuará em projetos estratégicos, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento, interoperabilidade e integração entre sistemas.


Requisitos Essenciais

Experiência sólida em C# .NET Framework 4.5 e .NET Core.

Conhecimento em SQL Server e ORMs (Entity Framework).

Experiência com integrações REST/SOAP.

Vivência em metodologias ágeis.

Experiência com CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps).

Experiência em batch/processamento (Control-M).

Testes unitários e integrados.


Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Manutenção

Desenvolver e manter aplicações em .NET Framework 4.5 e .NET Core (C#, ASP .net Core , MVC, Web API).

Implementar integrações com APIs REST, SOAP e serviços externos.

Garantir código limpo, seguro e aderente às boas práticas.

Atuar em processos batch e de processamento (Control-M, aplicações EXE).

Implementar interoperabilidade entre sistemas (C# + DLLs VB6).

Arquitetura e Design

Avaliar tecnologias e propor soluções escaláveis e resilientes.

Elaborar desenho de arquitetura desde o início dos projetos.

Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade do código (ex.: SonarQube).

Qualidade e Testes

Criar e manter testes unitários, integrados e automatizados.

Utilizar ferramentas de testes integrados.

Participar de code reviews e assegurar conformidade com padrões internos e regulatórios.

DevOps e Deploy

Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

Automatizar processos de build e deploy.

Monitorar aplicações em produção, analisando logs e métricas para prevenção de falhas.


Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto e CLT / PJ


Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

Boa capacidade de organização, de atenção e proatividade;

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of Information & Communication Engineering
description:
Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work. Please read the recruitment requirements carefully. Thank you.


WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.

title: Staff Full Stack Software Engineer (Java & Angular)
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos buscando um Senior Full Stack Engineer Java para atuar diretamente no time de nosso cliente localizado na Nova Zelândia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de uma aplicação SaaS em um ambiente de equipe colaborativa e multifuncional.


Horário de Trabalho:

É necessário disponibilidade para comunicação com o time do cliente entre 18h e 22h (BRT) - Segunda a Quinta-feira BRT .


Requisito Obrigatório:

Inglês fluente para comunicação verbal e escrita com equipes internacionais.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Desenvolver e manter uma aplicação SaaS utilizando Java, Angular e MySQL
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais e Product Managers para implementar novas funcionalidades
  • Contribuir para decisões arquiteturais e design técnico
  • Participar de cerimônias Agile e fornecer estimativas precisas de desenvolvimento
  • Realizar revisão de código e garantir altos padrões de qualidade


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Java: Mínimo de 12 anos de experiência incluindo JUnit, Hibernate, Spring Frameworks e Gradle
  • Angular: Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência utilizando Angular, Tailwind, Jest ou similares
  • Banco de Dados MySQL: Design e otimização de queries, profiling,
  • Serviços AWS: EC2, ECS, RDS, Lambda, etc
  • CI/CD e Testes Automatizados: Expêriencia com BuildKite, Jenkins ou similares


Habilidades Profissionais:

  • Inglês fluente para comunicação e eficaz com equipes técnicas e não técnicas, especialmente em ambientes remotos
  • Colaboração ativa em equipes multifuncionais internacionais
  • Documentação técnica clara e detalhada
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver desafios técnicos


Responsabilidades de Segurança:

  • Aderir à Política de Segurança de TI da empresa
  • Seguir as diretrizes do OWASP Top 10
  • Participar de treinamentos de segurança, conforme necessário


Outros Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade para comunicação dentro do horário mencionado
  • Compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento profissional
  • Alinhamento com os valores da empresa
